from.place: the idempotent existence and uniqueness component

title: Idempotent lifting from etale section lifting
statement: Under the etale section lifting hypothesis, every idempotent in a finite A-algebra modulo IB lifts uniquely to an idempotent in the algebra.

proof.text: Use the étale neighbourhood lifting construction and descend the lifted idempotent along the section; uniqueness follows from the Jacobson radical congruence argument.

mathlib_searches.query: finite algebra idempotent lift modulo ideal henselian
mathlib_searches.results: no direct match; only nilpotent-kernel lifting

lean.statement:
theorem etale_section_lifting_idempotents (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
    (h : ∀ (A' : Type (max u v)) [CommRing A'] [Algebra A A'] [Algebra.Etale A A']
      (σ : A' →ₐ[A] A ⧸ I), ∃ τ : A' →ₐ[A] A, (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ A I).comp τ = σ) :
    ∀ (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra A B] [Module.Finite A B]
      (e₀ : B ⧸ I.map (algebraMap A B)), IsIdempotentElem e₀ → ∃! e : B,
        IsIdempotentElem e ∧ Ideal.Quotient.mk (I.map (algebraMap A B)) e = e₀
